title: 我的一天

explanations.2: This word indicates the day of the week (Sunday).
explanations.3: This preposition connects the subject with family members (with).
explanations.4: This adverb shows the first action in the sequence (first).
explanations.5: This verb describes the action of eating (eat).
explanations.6: This noun is the object of eating in the morning (breakfast).
explanations.7: This measure word is used for cups of liquid (cup).
explanations.8: This noun is the drink consumed (milk).
explanations.9: This noun is the food eaten (steamed bun).
explanations.10: This negative adverb indicates an action did not happen (didn't).
explanations.11: This noun is the food eaten by dad (bread).
explanations.12: This adverb indicates an ongoing action (in the process of).
explanations.13: This noun specifies the location where the action takes place (room).
explanations.14: This location word indicates being inside (inside).
explanations.15: This noun is the piece of furniture where the book is placed (table).
explanations.16: This location word indicates the surface (on).
explanations.17: This noun is the object under the chair (mobile phone).
explanations.18: This noun is the piece of furniture (chair).
explanations.19: This noun is the animal in front of the table (cat).
explanations.20: This noun is the animal behind the chair (dog).

translation: Today is Sunday. I am at home with my parents. In the morning, I get up first, then eat breakfast. I drink a glass of milk and eat two steamed buns. Mom also eats breakfast; she drinks tea. Dad doesn't drink milk; he eats a piece of bread. In the morning, I am reading a book in my room. My book is on the table, my phone is under the chair, my cat is in front of the table, and my dog is behind the chair. Dad asks me how many pages I have read; I say ten pages. Mom asks me whether I am reading that book; I say no, I am reading this one. At noon we eat lunch together. We eat rice and dishes. I also eat an apple. Mom asks me what I ate, steamed bun or rice; I say rice. In the afternoon, we can go watch a movie. The movie is very good. We all like it. In the evening, I can write Chinese characters. I write twenty characters, then go to sleep.
